articles.summary: State Street research finds institutions increasingly prioritize regulatory clarity, cybersecurity and digital cash infrastructure as adoption scales. State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) today released findings from its 2026 Digital Assets Study 1 , showing that institutional investors are becoming increasingly confident in the long-term future of digital assets while placing greater emphasis on trust, cybersecurity, regulation and market infrastructure as adoption grows. The global study of 300 asset managers, asset owners and wealth managers found that 51% expect digital assets to become mainstream within five years, if they have not already, up from 42% in 2025 and 11% in 2024. Just 3% believe digital assets will never become mainstream. Operational readiness is also rising. More than one-third (35%) of respondents already manage or distribute digital assets, while another 28% have the provider relationships and infrastructure in place to do so if client demand arises. articles.summary: State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) today announced the election of Alexander Vollert to its Board of Directors. Vollert brings more than two decades of leadership experience across global financial services, with deep expertise in technology, operations, and large-scale transformation. Most recently, Vollert served as Group Chief Operating Officer of AXA and Chief Executive Officer of AXA Group Operations, where he led approximately 10,000 employees across 18 countries and was responsible for data and AI, IT strategy and delivery, operations, procurement, and security. He previously served as Chief Executive Officer of AXA Germany and held senior leadership roles at Allianz, including Chief Executive Officer of its German property and casualty business. “Alexander has spent much of his career at the intersection of technology, operations and financial services,” said Ronald P.
